differencesAndCorrections.expected: The mobile run reports an actual 390x844 viewport.
differencesAndCorrections.firstActual: The first override was applied before creating the target tab and the target remained 1280x720.
differencesAndCorrections.correction: Applied the viewport override to the active browser after the target tab existed and verified innerWidth/innerHeight before interaction.

differencesAndCorrections.expected: A cold production build mounts one React root without the development HMR warning.
differencesAndCorrections.firstActual: Editing main.tsx while the dev server was live caused Vite HMR to report repeated createRoot calls during invalidation.
differencesAndCorrections.correction: Stopped the dev server, completed the production build, and started the locked Vite preview from a clean process.
differencesAndCorrections.retest: The production input route completed, #root had exactly one child before and after restart, no createRoot text was rendered, and the preview terminal emitted no React error.

differencesAndCorrections.expected: Lifecycle reset follows project semantic identity, not React object identity.
differencesAndCorrections.firstActual: The initial effect depended on the project object reference and would reset for an equivalent cloned object.
differencesAndCorrections.correction: Changed the dependency to the Canonical project semantic hash.
differencesAndCorrections.retest: An equivalent clone preserved waiting-choice; a different Media project reset to title.
